content.title: About
content.content: Monster Low Calorie is a near‑zero‑calorie energy drink containing about 10 kcal per 100 ml. It delivers the classic Monster flavor with taurine, caffeine, B‑vitamins and guarana extract, providing a quick energy boost without excess calories.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The drink belongs to the “Low Calorie” line created for calorie‑conscious consumers.
Caffeine content is roughly 32 mg per 100 ml, comparable to regular Monster.
It includes vitamin B12, which supports red blood cell formation.
Available in several flavors such as “Zero Sugar” and “Fruit Punch”.
Packaged in recyclable aluminum cans to reduce environmental impact.

items.title: Increased alertness
items.content: Caffeine and taurine stimulate the central nervous system, improving focus and reaction time.

items.title: Metabolism support
items.content: B‑vitamins help convert food into usable energy, promoting a more efficient metabolism.

items.title: Low calorie content
items.content: Approximately 10 kcal per 100 ml allows for an energy boost without significantly raising daily caloric intake.

items.title: Antioxidant effect
items.content: Guarana extract contains polyphenols that may protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Enhanced physical endurance
items.content: The combination of caffeine and taurine can reduce perceived fatigue during intense exercise.

items.title: Caffeine sensitivity
items.content: Individuals sensitive to caffeine may experience anxiety, rapid heartbeat, or sleep disturbances.

items.title: Not for children or pregnant women
items.content: Due to high caffeine levels, the drink is not recommended for children, adolescents, pregnant or nursing women.

items.title: Drug interactions
items.content: Caffeine can amplify the effects of certain stimulants and diminish the efficacy of some sedatives.

items.title: Allergy to ingredients
items.content: Possible reactions to flavorings, colorants, or other additives used in the formula.

content.title: How to Consume
content.content: Drink Monster Low Calorie chilled, straight from the refrigerator. It is advisable to limit intake to 250 ml (one can) per occasion and avoid mixing with alcohol.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, consume within 3‑5 days for best quality.
